review_findings_addressed.F1: coupled_dynamics.hpp friction_solve exact-rest fallback inverted to s=(rt>=0.?-1.:1.) with the derivation comment (rt>0 means impending slip along -t; friction opposes it). review_findings_addressed.F4: qualify_coupled_live.py scope string updated to the friction-era truth (live Coulomb mu in [0,1] default 0 without reset, stick/slide with friction heat, mu=0 bit-exact frictionless). String-only change, py-compile verified; the live qualifier itself was NOT run to avoid resetting the operator's open scene on port 8127.
